method: Exhaustive review of all screen text blocks (explainer prose, video bridges, process_flow nodes, before_after blocks, data_table captions/highlights, up_next blocks, remediation prose) and all interaction prompts, options, feedback, and hints across both tiles. For each step, the step's concept_ids were identified and the blocked_future_concepts list for each concept was checked against the content. A passing mention in an up_next block was not counted as leakage per the evaluator instructions.

concept_blocked_pairs_checked.notes: Steps s01-s06 and remediations r01-r02 discuss only the four quality checks (completeness, uniqueness, validity, accuracy) and fitness for purpose. No reference to analysis workflow stages, ethics, or privacy.

Steps s07-s12 and remediation r03 discuss the six workflow stages and iterative looping. References to data quality checks are to the prerequisite concept (data.data_quality_basics), not to ethics/privacy. The communicate stage mentions sharing limitations but does not require understanding ethics/privacy concepts.
Last concept in tile; no intra-tile blocked concepts. Content discusses privacy, minimal collection, honest reporting, re-identification. No Python, stats, or later-path concepts.

Steps s01-s03 and remediation r01 discuss identifying the decision behind a stakeholder request and the engagement-and-scoping stage's role in establishing how analysis informs decisions. No mention of precise findings, well-formed statistical questions, specification documents, or requirements.

Steps s04-s07 and remediations r02-r03 discuss big-idea sentences, narrowing claims, adding numbers and comparisons. No mention of well-formed statistical questions, specification documents, or commissioner requirements.

Steps s08-s12 and remediations r04-r05 discuss restating vague questions as measurable analytical questions and agreeing on outputs. The output-agreement content in s09 teaches framing_analytical_question#f2 (assigned to this concept), not identifying_requirements#f5. No mention of specification documents, commissioner inputs, or sign-off processes.

Last concept in tile; no intra-tile blocked concepts. Content discusses commissioner inputs, specification documents, sign-off, resource/timeline constraints, and output agreement. No later-path concepts referenced.
